Maya (Marketing): Quick sync  were targeting publish for the 'Serving at Scale' launch next Tue 10:00 AM PT. Need legal / PR signoff and an exec quote by Mon EOD. Draft in /marketing/drafts/serving-at-scale.md

Jun (Product): Chart and perf table uploaded to /marketing/assets/serving-scale-chart.png. Please include a small note on test harness.

Priya (Legal): Ill review tonight. Avoid superlatives; please include p50/p95 numbers and a footnote describing hardware and quantization.

Leo (PR): Proposed embargo 9:30 AM PT, briefing at 8:45 AM PT. Top targets: TechCrunch, The Information, Wired, VentureBeat. Ill prepare an embargoed press kit (one-pager, hi-res charts, quote bank).

Maya (Marketing): Checklist Im tracking: legal signoff (Priya), exec quote (Jun to secure), customer quote clearance (Sophie), chart + footnote (Jun), analytics ID (Infra), schedule publish (PublishBot).

Jun (Product): Customer quote from Atlas is cleared by solutions team. Uploaded updated footnote: "Benchmarks run on our standard harness; models and quantization settings listed in appendix. Individual results may vary."

Priya (Legal): :thumbsup: signed off on wording and footnote. Removed the phrase "industry standard".

Leo (PR): Press kit shared to DM. Holding outreach until we confirm publish window. Do we want an embargoed briefing script?

Maya (Marketing): Yes, Leo draft a 5-min briefing script and paste here. Also plan social cadence: blog, 4-tweet thread, short CEO LinkedIn.

PublishBot: Publish job scheduled: channel=marketing/blog, publish_at=2026-05-12T17:00:00Z, embargo_until=2026-05-12T16:30:00Z, job_id=110220.

Jun (Product): Chart PNG final is /marketing/assets/serving-scale-chart-final.png. Confirmed analytics ID 1402 for UTM.

Maya (Marketing): Great. Please react :thumbsup: when ready to go live. We'll only proceed once all thumbs up.

Jun (Product): :thumbsup:

Priya (Legal): :thumbsup:

Leo (PR): :thumbsup:

Maya (Marketing): :thumbsup: Thanks team, will monitor on launch day and coordinate internal announce.
